summary: The implementation preserves short technical-valid tracks and generates specimen-level omission sensitivity under technical QC, but acceptance is blocked because the retained report provenance identifies a rebuild-script byte stream that matches neither the reviewed Git blob nor the current working copy. In addition, the cited full-suite validation predates the newly added reconciliation implementation and tests, so it cannot validate this commit-bound change.

findings.title: Retained report provenance does not bind to the reviewed rebuild implementation
findings.impact: The acceptance report and short-track sensitivity artifacts cannot be reproduced from the reviewed commit using the recorded generator identity. This breaks commit-bound provenance for a high-risk claim and prevents an independent reviewer from establishing which implementation generated the accepted artifacts.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json records rebuild-script SHA-256 `52481e3496ec08d9e35281b8e6c93f760fced88723a9e80b45501fd25def9bf1`.

Read-only hashing produced `9e9c89cb97db62bad266f3dcba24cb9aa2b3ab345ac09396a0008e4bbab6ce0b` for `git show HEAD:scripts/rebuild_v571_acceptance_report_from_replay.py` and `d83f951f9e8dedf0c348e5a90d784d7db3ede7f35e4c36e8de4024b160a46e1a` for the checkout file.
scripts/rebuild_v571_acceptance_report_from_replay.py:400-408 records the rebuild-script and sensitivity hashes in the source-binding artifact.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the retained report package from a clean checkout of the intended commit, record both canonical Git-blob and exact execution-byte hashes for the rebuild script, validate those hashes against the reviewed commit, and run a superseding append-only audit.

findings.title: The validation receipt predates the new reconciliation code and tests
findings.impact: The receipt's 231-test success does not demonstrate that the reviewed commit's new report reconstruction, mismatch rejection, serialization, and artifact-binding paths execute successfully. The newly added positive test also asserts only counts after reconciliation, providing limited protection against incorrect median or hash serialization.

findings.recommendation: Run the complete suite and focused replay tests at the reviewed commit in the validated virtual environment with a writable explicit `--basetemp`; add negative tests for fraction, length-median, width-median, missing-column, duplicate-specimen, and non-finite-value mismatches, plus an end-to-end report rebuild test that verifies the recorded generator identity.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as required by the review scope.

Focused pytest and tuner self-check execution were blocked by the managed read-only filesystem: pytest had no usable temporary directory, and the tuner self-check failed when creating its temporary directory.
GUI behavior was traced statically and through existing tests; no interactive GUI session was launched.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
recommended_follow_up: Regenerate the report-source binding from a clean, reviewed commit and make its generator identity verifiable against the Git blob and execution bytes.
Produce a validation receipt explicitly bound to commit 22d29621230d31e2cf812ec28bec680d984ad2de after running the focused and full suites in the validated virtual environment.
Submit the corrected evidence and validation under a new append-only audit run; the present blocking result cannot be accepted conditionally.
